questions.question: Inorder: D B E A F C G. Preorder: A B D E C F G. Reconstruct the tree and give its postorder.
questions.solutionApproach: Root=A (preorder first). Inorder split: [D B E] left, [F C G] right. Left subtree preorder=[B D E], root=B, inorder-split: [D] left, [E] right → B has left-child D, right-child E. Right subtree preorder=[C F G], root=C, inorder-split:[F] left,[G] right → C has left F, right G. Tree: A(B(D,E), C(F,G)). Postorder: D E B F G C A.
questions.answer: Postorder: D E B F G C A

questions.question: A binary tree where every node has 0 or 2 children has 41 leaf nodes. How many total nodes does it have?
questions.solutionApproach: n0=n2+1 → n2=40. Total n=n0+n2=41+40=81 (no degree-1 nodes in this tree type).
